text.p: These are the leading stories in Zambia's newspapers on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- The Zambian National Union of Communication Workers has rejected the privatisation of the Zambia Telecommunications Company (Zamtel), union official Neddy Nzowa said.
- The first session of Zambia's new parliament will start sitting on December 6.
- President Frederick Chiluba has with immediate effect dissolved his cabinet, a State House spokesman said on Thursday.
- Human Rights Watch Africa has urged the World Bank, the United States and the Southern African Development Community (SADC) to pressure Zambia to improve its human rights record.
